title: A timeline colors every cell of a row in one action
body: A `fill` action on a row (`fill r 3 #ffcc00`) colors one cell, and `fill r #ffcc00` on the whole row does not reach cells that set their own fill. Tinting a row by partition in `figures/sufr-build.acre` took one action per cell, or a box drawn behind the row. The proposal is that a row-wide `fill`, `stroke` and `text-color` color every cell.
close_reason: Landed in 1579407. `timeline::by_cell` splits a row-wide `fill`, `stroke` or `text-color` run into one run per cell, joined to the cell's own run, so each cell has its own track. Matrix span flaw filed as acre-92251d.
